bagPolicy.summary: The O2 enforces a bag policy for safety, allowing only A4 size bags or smaller into the arena. Large bags must be stored at a facility outside the main entrance.
bagPolicy.note: American Express Cardholders receive complimentary bag drop.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at The O2 can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The O2's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The O2 Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, from burgers and pizzas to burritos and stir fry. Special highlights include the Lanson Champagne Bar and the Mixology Bar with unique cocktails. Exclusive areas like Sky Backstage and O2 Blueroom provide additional experiences for Sky and O2 customers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The O2, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The O2's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The O2. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The O2. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
